# `Q-5-39` — Invalid website.search Value

> A `website.search` option has a value of the wrong type or outside
> its allowed values. The default is used instead.

## What this means

Each `website.search` option takes a specific kind of value. When a
value does not fit, Quarto warns and renders with that option's
default, so a configuration mistake never breaks the render.

```yaml
# _quarto.yml
website:
  search:
    location: footer      # Q-5-39: must be `navbar` or `sidebar`
    limit: -3             # Q-5-39: must be a positive integer
```

Expected values:

| Option | Accepts |
|---|---|
| `location` | `navbar` or `sidebar` |
| `type` | `overlay` or `textbox` |
| `limit` | a positive integer |
| `collapse-after` | a positive integer, or `false` |
| `copy-button`, `merge-navbar-crumbs`, `search-json` | `true` or `false` |
| `keyboard-shortcut` | a key, or a list of keys |
| `show-item-context` | `tree`, `parent`, `root`, `true`, or `false` |
| `federate` | a list of site URLs or maps with a `url` |
| `federate[].weight` | a positive number |
| `algolia` | a map of Algolia settings |

A `federate` entry without a `url` is reported with this code and
skipped.

## How to fix it

Change the value to one of the accepted forms listed above.
